items.description: BURKINA-KOOSIN-CAMPAGNE-AGRICOLE Koosin/Agriculture : Les producteurs de Kenekuy entament le buttage des champs Dokuy, 8 sept. 2026 (AIB)-Les producteurs de Kenekuy, dans la province de la Koosin, ont entamé ce mardi 8 septembre 2026, le buttage de leurs champs, profitant des dernières pluies qui ont permis d’améliorer l’état des cultures, après une longue période de sécheresse. Dans son champ de petit mil, Eli Kienou s’est attelé, comme plusieurs autres producteurs du village, aux travaux de buttage des plants. Selon lui, la campagne agricole évolue relativement bien dans la plupart des champs de Kenekuy, malgré les difficultés liées à l’irrégularité des pluies. « Nous avons profité de la dernière pluie pour commencer le buttage. Malgré la longue période de sécheresse, le petit mil a pu résister et aujourd’hui, les champs se présentent bien », a-t-il indiqué. Le producteur se dit optimiste pour la suite de la campagne et estime que la poursuite des pluies pourrait permettre aux agriculteurs d’obtenir de bonnes récoltes à la fin de la saison. Eli Kienou a également salué l’engagement des Volontaires pour la défense de la patrie (VDP), dont la contribution à la sécurisation de Kenekuy permet, selon lui, aux populations de poursuivre leurs activités agricoles avec davantage de sérénité. items.title: Benin-Asaba Road: Umahi breaks concession deadlock, orders emergency repairs
items.description: By Egufe Yafugborhi ASABA — Minister of Works, Senator David Umahi, has ordered the immediate mobilisation of major contractors to all three sections of the troubled Benin-Asaba Road, saying public interest must take precedence over the existing concession agreement. Umahi, in a statement on Wednesday, said the condition of the highway had reached a stage where contractual constraints could no longer frustrate urgent government intervention. According to him, “The Benin-Asaba Road situation has reached a point where overall public interest must take precedence over the existing concession agreement.” The minister recalled that during his recent visit to the road, he assembled contractors and directed them to prepare for palliative works. However, he said the concession agreement required the consent of the concessionaire before the Federal Government could intervene. “Permission was not granted,” he said, adding that he subsequently presented three options to the concessionaire, but “none of the options was accepted.” Umahi said that after he left Asaba, the equipment deployed to the road was reduced to just one, making meaningful intervention impossible. He has now directed the immediate mobilisation of major contractors to the three sections of the road, with the Federal Government to bear the cost of the emergency works. The minister also ordered the immediate redesign of the entire Benin-Asaba route for reinforced concrete pavement, saying the measure would provide a more durable solution to the persistent deterioration of the highway. The latest directive comes as the Federal Government has commenced emergency repairs on the ageing First Niger Bridge, popularly known as the Onitsha Headbridge. The bridge was closed to traffic on Monday, September 7, for emergency maintenance scheduled to run until September 21. The intervention involves removing the deteriorated asphalt surface and laying an approximately 40mm asphalt wearing course, as well as repairing damaged bridge components affected by vandalism. The Federal Government has directed motorists to use the Second Niger Bridge through Obosi towards Asaba and other destinations during the closure. Solar-powered streetlights and closed-circuit television, CCTV, cameras are also to be installed as part of measures to improve safety and curb vandalism. Umahi said other critical federal roads were also receiving urgent attention, including Benin-Sapele, Ifaki-Kabba, Sokoto-Zamfara-Katsina, Abuja-Kaduna-Zaria-Kano, Bauchi-Jigawa, Sagamu-Ore, East-West Road, Abuja-Lokoja, Lokoja-Benin-Warri and sections of the Lagos-Ibadan Highway. He said the Federal Government was working on more than 80 per cent of inherited federal roads, stressing that the administration was committed to delivering infrastructure capable of serving Nigerians for decades. “Concrete pavement is designed to last between 50 and 100 years. The concerns of Nigerians are legitimate, and we are listening. But we cannot resolve every challenge accumulated over the years within three years,” he said. The minister said the emergency interventions were part of efforts to restore critical transport corridors and reduce the hardship being experienced by motorists and businesses across the country. The post Benin-Asaba Road: Umahi breaks concession deadlock, orders emergency repairs appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Cyril Hadzi announces new record after growing worship music catalogue
items.description: Ghanaian worship leader Cyril Hadzi has announced a new record as he continues building a catalogue centred on prayer, intimacy with God and worship. Known for his reverent worship sessions and Spirit-led spontaneous moments, Hadzi has released several songs that reflect his focus on the presence of God. His music includes Mighty Man of War , Yesu Mo, Dufia , There Is a Name and Every Nation , which features Ella Agyinasare. Among his recent releases is The Arise Project , a four-track worship project featuring It’s Been You, You Are God , Yaweh Arise and Yaweh Turned It . The project presents extended worship expressions that draw attention to God’s faithfulness, His sovereignty and His power to intervene in the lives of His people. Hadzi’s music is shaped by his work as both a worship leader and songwriter. His songs often emerge from personal prayer and devotion, giving his ministry a sound that is reflective, faith-filled and focused on helping listeners engage with God beyond the usual worship setting. Through live recordings, devotional content and spontaneous worship sessions shared across digital platforms, he has created a space for believers seeking more than songs alone. His ministry emphasises worship as a lifestyle of surrender and a pathway to a more personal walk with God. The worship minister has also announced that a new record is coming soon. While further details about the project are yet to be released, the forthcoming record is expected to continue Hadzi’s message of devotion, prayer and hunger for God’s presence. items.title: Ebonyi govt condemns Abuja protest against Nwifuru
items.description: By Jeff Agbodo, Abakaliki The Ebonyi State Government has condemned a reported protest in Abuja against Governor Francis Nwifuru, describing the demonstration and narratives surrounding it as politically motivated. The Commissioner for Information and Orientation, Chief Ikeuwah Omebeh, stated this while briefing journalists at his office at the Old Government House, Abakaliki. Omebeh said although the Nwifuru administration remained open to criticism, such criticism should be based on facts and evidence rather than what he described as misinformation. He said the reported protest and some narratives surrounding it were “laughable and poorly coordinated,” adding that they appeared to be directed at the governor and his administration. According to him, the government recognises and respects citizens’ constitutional rights to express their opinions and engage in peaceful protests, but such rights should not be exploited to mislead the public or create unnecessary tension. “While the government recognises and respects the constitutional rights of citizens to express their opinions and to engage in peaceful protests, it is important to state clearly that such rights should not be abused or exploited by individuals and groups whose objective is to deliberately mislead the public, create unnecessary tension or diminish the tremendous progress being recorded across the state,” he said. Omebeh urged Ebonyi residents to remain calm and discerning, saying they should disregard narratives that were not supported by facts, evidence or the realities on the ground. He said Nwifuru’s administration had, since assuming office, invested in infrastructure, education, healthcare, human capital development, workers’ welfare, rural development, empowerment programmes and social interventions. He attributed the administration’s policies to its “People’s Charter of Needs” philosophy, which he said placed the interests and welfare of residents at the centre of governance. Omebeh said political opposition was expected in a democratic system but argued that criticism should not be based on what he described as propaganda or misinformation. “What is unacceptable, however, is the attempt to substitute facts with propaganda, development with misinformation, and constructive criticism with politically motivated attacks,” he said. The commissioner said the government was particularly concerned about narratives that could distract residents from projects and programmes being implemented across the state. He listed road construction, rehabilitation of schools, improvements in healthcare facilities, workers’ welfare, rural development and empowerment programmes among areas he said the administration had focused on. Omebeh urged residents to assess the government based on its record and impact rather than political narratives. “Let the people visit the communities, inspect the projects and speak directly with the beneficiaries of government programmes. The evidence of governance is visible across the state,” he said. He also assured residents that Governor Nwifuru remained focused on his administration’s development agenda and would not be distracted by what he described as political theatrics or attacks. According to him, Ebonyi needs unity, constructive engagement and development-focused criticism rather than controversies capable of undermining public confidence. “The government remains open to legitimate criticism and constructive suggestions. Indeed, a responsible administration must listen to its people. But criticism must be founded on facts, patriotism and genuine concern for the common good,” Omebeh said. He urged youths and other residents not to allow themselves to be used by individuals whose interests, he alleged, might differ from those of the state. “Governor Francis Ogbonna Nwifuru remains focused on governance. Ebonyi remains focused on development. And the people remain the ultimate beneficiaries. “Let us, therefore, disregard the distractions, reject misinformation and remain united in the pursuit of a greater Ebonyi State,” he said. The post Ebonyi govt condemns Abuja protest against Nwifuru appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Alia seized 23 vehicles allocated to him, court ordered their return — Ortom alleges
items.description: Former Benue State Governor, Samuel Ortom, has alleged that his successor, Governor Hyacinth Alia, seized 23 vehicles that had been allocated to him by the state government after he left office. Ortom, who disclosed this on Tuesday during an appearance on Arise Television’s Morning Show, said he challenged the seizure in court and secured a judgment ordering the state government to return the vehicles and pay him N5 million in damages. According to him, the vehicles were legitimately allocated to him by the state government before he left office. “After I left office, vehicles that were given to me legitimately by the government, this government (Alia administration) went and seized them in a manner that was not befitting. “No communication was made to me. I went to court, and we defeated the government. And they were asked to pay me N5 million in addition to returning the 23 vehicles they took away from me, which were legitimately given to me by the government,” he said. Ortom alleged that the seizure was part of what he described as the Alia administration’s “witch-hunt” of political opponents. The former governor also accused the Alia administration of sidelining political stakeholders from the affairs of the state, alleging that no stakeholders’ meeting involving political parties had been held since the governor assumed office. Ortom further alleged that Alia recently directed traditional rulers not to receive him when he visited his kinsmen to inform them about his wife’s senatorial ambition. He also claimed that local government chairmen in the state were yet to gain control of their funds despite the Supreme Court’s judgment affirming financial autonomy for local governments. Alia, a member of the All Progressives Congress, APC, succeeded Ortom as governor on May 29, 2023, after defeating Titus Uba, the Peoples Democratic Party, PDP, candidate who was backed by the former governor. Belgique : Thibaut Courtois met sa carrière internationale en pause
items.description: Thibaut Courtois a décidé de faire l’impasse sur la prochaine Ligue des Nations, tout en maintenant son objectif de retrouver les Diables Rouges pour les qualifications à l’Euro 2028. Thibaut Courtois prend du recul avec la sélection belge. Le portier du Real Madrid ne participera pas à la prochaine campagne de Ligue des Nations, mais n’entend pas pour autant tourner définitivement le dos aux Diables Rouges. Âgé de 34 ans, Courtois a confirmé cette décision après la victoire du Real Madrid face à l’Inter Milan en Ligue des champions. Il a expliqué avoir pris cette décision à la suite d’un échange avec le nouveau sélectionneur belge, Mark van Bommel. Après le Mondial 2026, au cours duquel la Belgique a atteint les quarts de finale, le gardien avait annoncé son intention de prendre une année sabbatique avec l’équipe nationale afin de souffler physiquement et de se concentrer sur ses performances en club. Le portier madrilène assure toutefois qu’il compte revenir en sélection pour les qualifications à l’Euro 2028. Une perspective qui pourrait néanmoins s’accompagner d’une concurrence accrue à son poste. Mark van Bommel lui aurait indiqué qu’il ne pouvait pas lui garantir une place de titulaire à son retour. Courtois accepte cette situation, tout en affichant clairement son ambition de reconquérir le statut de numéro un. « Je serai de nouveau disponible pour les qualifications à l’Euro. Mais Mark van Bommel m’a répondu qu’il ne pouvait pas me garantir une place de titulaire » , a expliqué le gardien belge. « Si le gardien qui dispute la Ligue des Nations réalise de bonnes performances, le sélectionneur pourrait lui faire confiance à nouveau. Cependant, je veux me battre pour ma place. Je veux prouver que je peux redevenir le gardien numéro un », a-t-il ajouté. Courtois ne sera donc pas présent lors des prochaines échéances de la Belgique face à l’Italie et à la France, prévues à la fin du mois de septembre. Son objectif reste toutefois clair : revenir plus fort et récupérer sa place dans les buts des Diables Rouges à l’approche des qualifications pour l’Euro 2028. The post Belgique : Thibaut Courtois met sa carrière internationale en pause appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: ‘We can’t boast of $100k in savings’, Nigerian woman laments struggles in US
items.description: By Sekinat Osundiji A Nigerian woman living in the United States has expressed frustration over the financial and immigration challenges facing some immigrants in the country, saying many who have spent decades in America may still struggle to build substantial savings. The woman, who shared her concerns in a viral video on social media, said she was “tired of America” because of what she described as the worsening situation for immigrants. “I am tired of America, the situation is getting worse for the immigrants everyday. I’ve been here for over two decades and I can’t even boast of $100k in my savings” A Nigerian woman living in America voiced out her frustration and what other immigrants are facing pic.twitter.com/drNJNGxUyh — Big Uncle (@Usmanashafe) September 9, 2026 According to her, she has spent more than two decades in the United States but questioned whether many immigrants in her situation could boast of having $100,000 in savings. “I’m tired of America. The situation is getting worse for the immigrants every day,” she said. “Majority of us that have been in this country for the last over two decades, can we boast of $100,000 in savings? Ah, omo, we plenty, plenty of us don’t have.” She explained that her frustration was not necessarily because she wanted to return to Nigeria, but because of the current situation in the US, particularly concerns surrounding immigration. The woman urged immigrants and their families to stay informed about developments in the country, saying some information about immigration policies and legal issues may not always be widely reported in mainstream news. She also encouraged immigrants to follow immigration lawyers and other credible sources for updates. According to her, some Nigerians and other immigrants who have spent decades in the US may have invested significant time, money and resources without achieving the financial security they expected. “A lot of us that we have been in this country for over two decades, a lot of us wasted time, we wasted money, we wasted resources,” she said. She further said that returning to Nigeria may not be an easy option for many immigrants, not necessarily because of the desire to remain in America, but because they may lack the financial capacity to start over. “Going back to Nigeria is not even the problem,” she said. “But a lot of people don’t have that financial capacity to stand.” The woman also appealed to Nigerians in Africa and Europe to be mindful of the financial pressures on relatives living in the US, particularly those who regularly depend on them for money. She urged families to reduce financial demands on relatives in America and to understand that living in the US does not automatically mean an individual is financially comfortable. “A lot of people that you are relying on your family member in America for daily needs and feeding and all of those things in Africa, please, this is not the time to be billing your family member in America,” she said. She ended her message by urging Nigerians to keep their loved ones in America in their prayers. Vanguard News The post ‘We can’t boast of $100k in savings’, Nigerian woman laments struggles in US appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Felipe VI et l’état-major réunis sur fond de crise à Sebta
items.description: La question de l'enclave occupée de Sebta continue d’occuper une place sensible dans le débat politique et sécuritaire espagnol. Lundi, le Roi Felipe VI a présidé au palais de la Zarzuela une réunion consacrée à la situation de l’enclave occupée, abordée « du point de vue de la défense », selon les termes employés par la Maison royale. Autour du souverain, la ministre de la Défense, Margarita Robles, ainsi que plusieurs hauts responsables militaires ont participé à cette rencontre à forte portée symbolique. L’initiative a été rendue publique par la Maison royale elle-même, qui a diffusé une photographie montrant le monarque en uniforme militaire aux côtés des responsables présents. Un choix de communication qui n’est pas passé inaperçu. Comme l’a relevé le quotidien espagnol El País , ni l’agenda officiel de la Maison royale ni celui de la ministre de la Défense ne faisaient mention de cette réunion avant sa divulgation sur les réseaux sociaux. En sa qualité de chef suprême des forces armées, Felipe VI a dirigé les échanges auxquels ont notamment pris part le chef d’état-major de la Défense, l’amiral général Teodoro Esteban López Calderón, le chef du Commandement des opérations, le lieutenant-général José Antonio Agüero, le chef du Commandement opérationnel terrestre, le lieutenant-général Julio Salom, ainsi que le commandant général de Sebta, le général de division Luis Jesús Fernández Herrero. Cette réunion intervient dans un contexte marqué par une attention croissante portée à Sebta et Melilla en Espagne. La vague migratoire enregistrée à Sebta à la fin du mois de juillet, au cours de laquelle les autorités espagnoles ont signalé l’arrivée d’un nombre important de migrants, a ravivé les préoccupations sécuritaires autour des deux enclaves. Elle a également relancé les débats politiques sur leur avenir et sur l’évolution des relations entre Madrid et Rabat. Selon El País , la diffusion de l’image du souverain en tenue militaire aux côtés de la ministre de la Défense et de l’état-major constitue un message adressé en premier lieu à l’opinion publique espagnole. Il s’agit de souligner l’implication du Roi dans les questions liées à la défense des frontières. Cette mise en scène peut également être interprétée comme un signal envoyé à l’extérieur, notamment au Maroc. La rencontre s’inscrit par ailleurs dans une controverse politique plus large autour du rôle du monarque dans le dossier de Sebta et Melilla. L’opposition avait précédemment accusé le chef du gouvernement, Pedro Sánchez, d’avoir empêché une visite que Felipe VI souhaitait effectuer dans les deux villes. Après la pause estivale, le président du gouvernement a toutefois affirmé, lors d’un entretien accordé à la radio Cadena SER , soutenir ce déplacement, indiquant qu’il pourrait avoir lieu dans les prochaines semaines. Une telle visite ne manquerait pas de susciter une réaction attentive à Rabat. La dernière visite d’un souverain espagnol à Sebta et Melilla remonte à 2007, lorsque Juan Carlos Ier s’était rendu dans les deux enclaves sous le gouvernement de José Luis Rodríguez Zapatero. Ce déplacement avait alors provoqué de fortes tensions diplomatiques entre le Maroc et l’Espagne. Du côté du gouvernement espagnol, des sources officielles considèrent néanmoins que la réunion entre Felipe VI, la ministre de la Défense et les chefs militaires relève d’un fonctionnement institutionnel normal, compte tenu des liens particuliers qui unissent le souverain aux forces armées. Ces mêmes sources assurent que le palais de la Moncloa avait été informé en amont de la tenue de la rencontre et qu’il voyait d’un bon œil aussi bien son organisation que sa médiatisation. El País relève toutefois que la visibilité croissante du Roi dans des dossiers à forte dimension politique et sécuritaire suscite certaines réserves au sein de l’exécutif. Des responsables gouvernementaux rappellent régulièrement que la Constitution espagnole définit clairement le rôle du monarque, qui ne gouverne pas et dont les actes officiels sont soumis au principe du « contreseing » gouvernemental. Les ministres demeurent, à cet égard, les responsables politiques des actes du chef de l’État devant le Parlement et l’opinion publique. Au cours de la réunion, les participants ont examiné la situation de Sebta sous l’angle de la défense, une formulation qui témoigne de l’importance croissante accordée à l’enclave dans les calculs sécuritaires et militaires espagnols. Cette préoccupation n’est pas nouvelle. Après les épisodes de migration massive ayant marqué Sebta, Felipe VI avait exprimé sa « profonde préoccupation » et sa « vive réprobation » face à ce que la Maison royale avait qualifié de « graves événements ». Le souverain avait alors insisté sur la nécessité d’adopter toutes les mesures permettant d’adresser un message « clair et ferme » aux habitants de Sebta et Melilla quant au soutien du reste de l’Espagne. Le Roi avait également souligné l’obligation pour l’État de garantir la sécurité des deux villes et d’empêcher la répétition de tels épisodes. Une position qui illustre la sensibilité particulière de ce dossier pour l’institution monarchique espagnole, alors que Sebta et Melilla devraient demeurer au cœur des discussions politiques et sécuritaires entre Madrid et Rabat dans les mois à venir. The post Felipe VI et l’état-major réunis sur fond de crise à Sebta appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: Patronising roadside traders risks six months’ jail — LAWMA
items.description: By Olasunkanmi Akoni The Lagos Waste Management Authority, LAWMA, has warned residents against patronising traders operating illegally on roads, medians, setbacks, walkways and other unauthorised public spaces, saying offenders risk arrest and prosecution. The Managing Director of LAWMA, Dr Muyiwa Gbadegesin, gave the warning on Tuesday at the authority’s headquarters in Lagos, saying enforcement would commence next week. He said the measure was part of a renewed enforcement strategy aimed at curbing illegal trading, indiscriminate waste disposal and obstruction of public infrastructure across Lagos State. According to Gbadegesin, enforcement would no longer be limited to illegal traders, as residents who patronise such traders could also be held liable under Section 151(2) of the Lagos State Environmental Management and Protection Law, 2017. “The law does not only prohibit illegal street trading. It also makes it an offence to buy goods exposed or offered for sale in prohibited places. “From next week, anyone found buying from traders operating on roadsides, medians, walkways, setbacks or other unauthorised spaces will be arrested, alongside the traders, and prosecuted in accordance with the law,” he said. Gbadegesin said anyone convicted of the offence could face a fine of N90,000, imprisonment for six months, or both. He explained that illegal roadside and median trading often generated waste that was dumped in drains, on roads and other public spaces, thereby obstructing drainage channels, worsening traffic conditions and creating public health risks. “Our objective is to stop the cycle that allows illegal trading and indiscriminate waste disposal to return after enforcement operations. “Traders occupy public spaces because people continue to patronise them. Buyers must understand that their actions sustain the problem and that they are also accountable under the law,” he said. Gbadegesin said the authority was also strengthening waste collection in inner streets and communities around previously cleared dumping hotspots. He said identified service gaps would be addressed, while deliberate dumping, re-dumping and patronage of illegal markets would attract enforcement. He urged residents and businesses to patronise recognised markets and use approved waste collection channels, stressing that personal convenience should not come at the expense of public health, environmental sanitation, road safety and the orderly use of shared spaces. Gbadegesin reaffirmed LAWMA’s commitment to sustained enforcement, stakeholder engagement and improved waste collection services as part of efforts to eliminate open dumping and achieve a cleaner Lagos. items.title: How to verify academic certificates online as FG launches portal
items.description: The Federal Government has introduced a fully automated system for the evaluation and authentication of academic certificates, allowing applicants to complete the process online without visiting the Federal Ministry of Education physically. The Federal Ministry of Education announced the development as part of efforts to simplify access to government services and reduce delays associated with the traditional process. Under the new system, applicants can submit their requests and complete the credential evaluation and authentication process through the Ministry’s dedicated online platform. Education Minister, Dr Maruf Tunji Alausa, said the initiative represents an important step in the Federal Government’s digital transformation programme and is aligned with President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda. According to the Ministry, the automated system is designed to reduce bureaucratic bottlenecks, speed up processing and improve transparency in academic credential verification. The system is also expected to make the service more accessible to Nigerians and applicants living outside the country. How to evaluate and authenticate your academic certificate online Applicants who need the Federal Ministry of Education to evaluate or authenticate their academic credentials can follow these steps: 1. Visit the official online platform Go to the Federal Ministry of Education’s dedicated credential evaluation and authentication platform: ESS Credential Verification Platform 2. Begin the credential verification process Applicants should use the platform to initiate their academic credential evaluation or authentication request and provide the information required by the Ministry. 3. Complete the application online The new system allows applicants to complete the process electronically, eliminating the previous need to visit the Ministry’s offices physically for the service. Applicants should ensure that the information and academic credential details submitted through the platform are accurate. 4. Track the evaluation or authentication process The automated platform is intended to make the process more structured and transparent, allowing requests to be handled electronically rather than relying on physical submissions and visits. 5. Contact the Ministry for enquiries Applicants who require clarification about the process can contact the Federal Ministry of Education through: Email: ess1@education.gov.ng Why the Federal Government introduced the online system The Ministry said the automation is aimed at reducing bureaucratic delays and making academic certificate verification more convenient. It is also expected to strengthen the integrity and credibility of Nigeria’s academic certification system. Beyond individual applicants, the system will provide a more structured way for institutions, employers and other stakeholders to verify academic qualifications. Dr Alausa said the Ministry would continue to use technology to modernise education governance, improve institutional efficiency and provide services centred on the needs of citizens. items.title: Osun poll: PDP disowns election tribunal petition, threatens sanctions
items.description: The Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) has disowned an election petition filed in its name challenging the victory of Gov. Ademola Adeleke in the Aug. 15 Osun governorship election. The party National Publicity Secretary, Mr Jungudo Mohammed, at a news conference on Wednesday in Abuja, said the party did not authorise, sponsor, nor approve petition number EPT/OS/GOV/02/2026 currently before the Election Petition Tribunal sitting in Osogbo. Mohammed said only the PDP National Legal Adviser possesses the constitutional mandate to institute or delegate legal proceedings on its behalf, but no such authorisation was granted for the suit. “We are here to tell you that the PDP did not authorise this petition, and it is not our case. The party did not institute, sponsor, approve, nor endorse the petition challenging the outcome of the Aug. 15 Osun governorship election,” he said. He also said that the party had already placed disclaimer advertisements on the action in major national daily newspapers. Mohammed said that the PDP was aware that one Ochai Jacob Otokpa, Esq., a legal practitioner, was purportedly responsible for filing the petition in the name of the party. Mohammed challenged the legal practitioner to produce any written instruction, authority, or mandate empowering him to act for the party. “We, therefore, challenge him to produce the authority, instruction, or mandate upon which he relied in assuming the locus to institute proceedings in the name of the Peoples Democratic Party. “Who instructed him? Who authorised him? By what authority did he purport to act in the name of the PDP? These are legitimate questions to which the party and the Nigerian public deserve clear answers,” he said. The spokesperson noted that the party’s candidate in the election had previously appeared on a television programme on Sept. 7 to publicly disclaim and disown the petition, affirming that he never engaged any legal practitioner to challenge the poll results. He disclosed that the legal department of the PDP was taking immediate steps to formally withdraw the unauthorised suit before the tribunal in Osogbo. Mohammed urged security agencies and relevant authorities to investigate the circumstances surrounding the fraudulent petition and take appropriate action against those involved. He also called on the Election Petition Tribunal, the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC), the Accord Party, Gov. Adeleke, and the public to disregard the petition in its entirety. Mohammed warned against the unauthorised use of the PDP name for selfish ends. Mohammed declared that the party would no longer tolerate actions aimed at ridiculing its brand. He threatened that the PDP would deploy disciplinary measures against any individuals involved, regardless of their status. “The PDP is a creation of the law, and we have taken it upon ourselves that those days are gone when we tolerated such flagrant attitudes that tend to ridicule the party. “We have decided to use the sledgehammer to deal with any individual, no matter how highly placed, whenever we find out that statements or positions are taken on behalf of the party without the due authority of the legitimate leadership of the party,” he said. ( NAN ) The post Osun poll: PDP disowns election tribunal petition, threatens sanctions appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Daily Insight for CEOs: Managing costs without weakening the business.
items.description: Cost management should not automatically mean cutting expenditure. The CEO’s responsibility is to distinguish between costs that create value and costs that create unnecessary complexity. Poorly considered cost reduction can damage customer experience, employee capability, innovation, and future growth. The objective is smarter spending—not simply lower spending. Key Strategies: Identify inefficient expenditure. Protect strategic investments. Improve operational productivity. Eliminate unnecessary duplication. Use technology to improve efficiency. CEO Leadership Actions. Review major cost drivers. Protect investments critical to future growth. Encourage efficiency without compromising quality. Actionable Tip . Ask: “Which costs should we eliminate, which should we reduce, and which should we increase because they create strategic value?” Why This Matters? Intelligent cost management improves profitability while protecting the organization’s ability to compete and grow. About the Author Ernest De-Graft Egyir, CEO advisor, Thought Leader and Founding CEO of Chief Executives Network Ghana, convenes the Ghana CEO Summit and served on Ghana’s Economic Dialogue Planning Committee.

items.title: Arrest thugs that stopped Obi within 24 hours, Igbo group tells Benue gov
items.description: By Emmanuel Iheaka The Igbo Heroes and Icons Foundation has called on the Benue State Governor, Rev. Fr. Hyacinth Alia, to identify and arrest within 24 hours the suspected thugs who allegedly prevented the presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, Peter Obi, from entering the state. Obi was in Benue on Tuesday for what he described as a humanitarian visit to sympathise with families affected by the killings in Yelwata. However, his convoy was reportedly blocked along the Makurdi-Gboko Road by youths carrying sticks and other objects, forcing him to turn back and proceed to Plateau State. Reacting to the incident, the Igbo Heroes and Icons Foundation said it raised serious concerns about political tolerance, citizens’ fundamental rights and the responsibility of government to protect every Nigerian, regardless of political affiliation. In a statement, the group said: “Campaigns have commenced, but even beyond campaigns, every Nigerian has the constitutional right to freedom of movement. “What makes this particular incident even more disturbing is that Mr Peter Obi said he was travelling to Benue to mourn with families who lost loved ones and to show solidarity with victims of the Yelwata killings.” The group said no political disagreement should justify the use of thuggery, intimidation or violence to prevent a presidential candidate or any Nigerian from moving freely within the country. It called on Governor Alia, as the Chief Security Officer of the state, to ensure that the identities of those responsible for the alleged obstruction are established and that anyone found to have participated in the incident is brought before the appropriate authorities. The foundation acknowledged the Benue State Government’s denial of involvement in the incident, saying this made an independent investigation even more necessary. According to the group, “If the government of Benue State had nothing to do with this incident, then it should be the first institution demanding a transparent investigation and the arrest of those who carried out the obstruction. “Government must not allow uncertainty and conflicting allegations to replace accountability.” The group, through its representative, Nsofor, said the incident should concern every Nigerian because an alleged attack on the freedom of movement of a major political figure could have wider implications for ordinary citizens. “If a prominent presidential candidate can be stopped on a public road by suspected thugs, Nigerians must ask themselves what protection is available to the ordinary citizen. “Democracy cannot survive where political disagreements are settled through intimidation and physical obstruction,” Nsofor said. The foundation urged Governor Alia to direct the appropriate security authorities to commence a transparent investigation, identify those responsible and arrest anyone found culpable where sufficient evidence exists. It also urged the governor to reassure Obi and Nigerians that his safety and freedom of movement would be protected in Benue State. The group further called on the Nigeria Police Force and other relevant security agencies to ensure adequate protection for all presidential candidates and political actors as the country approaches the 2027 general elections. “We will not sit back and watch the fundamental rights of Nigerians being eroded. Political competition must be based on ideas, policies and the choice of the people—not intimidation, thuggery or coercion,” the statement read. The foundation also appealed to the international community, civil society organisations and election observers to pay close attention to the conduct of political actors and security agencies as Nigeria moves towards the 2027 elections. “The 2027 election must be an election in which Nigerians are allowed to choose their leaders according to their conscience. Nobody should be prevented from campaigning, travelling, engaging citizens or presenting an alternative political vision through the deployment of violence or intimidation,” the group said. On the issue of the presidency and growing demands for greater political inclusion, the Igbo Heroes and Icons Foundation said Nigerians from every region should have a fair opportunity to aspire to the highest office in the country. “Since 1999, Nigerians from different parts of the country have occupied the presidency through the democratic process. The South-East also deserves a fair and legitimate opportunity to produce the President of Nigeria through the ballot box. “But that opportunity must be determined by competence, character, capacity and the free choice of Nigerians—not by coercion or suppression,” the group stated. Ouagadougou: les populations appelées au respect des règles lors des cortèges
items.description: La mairie de Ouagadougou invite les populations au respect «strict» des termes de l'arrêté encadrant la réglementation des cortèges, selon un communiqué diffusé le mardi 8 septembre 2026. Ainsi, il rappelle à tous les citoyens de la commune que la formation des cortèges est régie par l'arrêté N°2024-270/CO/M/CAB/DAJC du 12 décembre 2024 portant réglementation des cortèges dans la commune de Ouagadougou. En ces périodes où les autorités s'activent à garantir la sécurité pour tous, le Président de la délégation spéciale invite toute la population au respect strict des termes de l'arrêté suscité. items.title: Tchad : le gouvernement et ses partisans préparent la riposte à la crise pluviométrique
items.description: © (DR) Le ministre d’État, ministre des Finances, Tahir Hamid Nguilin, a présidé une réunion le 8 septembre 2026, pour évaluer la situation pluviométrique et pastorale à l’échelle nationale et définir les actions à entreprendre pour répondre efficacement à la situation qui se profile à l’horizon. D'autres membres du gouvernement ont pris part à cette séance de travail. Notamment les ministres en charge de l’Agriculture, du Commerce, de l’Élevage et des Affaires humanitaires. Des représentants des partenaires techniques et financiers, tels que la Banque mondiale, la Banque africaine de développement (BAD), l’UNICEF, le Programme des Nations Unies pour le développement (PNUD), l’Organisation internationale pour les migrations (OIM) et le Haut-Commissariat des Nations Unies pour les réfugiés (HCR), étaient également représentés. L’objectif décliné de cette session était de faire le point sur l’évolution de la saison des pluies et ses impacts sur les activités agricoles et pastorales, fait savoir le ministère des Finances. La réunion de travail visait également à renforcer la coordination entre le gouvernement et ses partenaires afin de répondre efficacement aux difficultés rencontrées par les populations. "Des dispositions utiles sont prises à cet effet", apprend-on. items.title: Tunisie-Italie | L’IA contre les incendies de forêt
items.description: Utiliser l'intelligence artificielle, les données géospatiales, l’imagerie satellitaire, les capteurs et les drones pour prévenir et gérer les incendies de forêt en Méditerranée : tel est l’objectif du projet Forfire-AI. Ce projet était au cœur de l’atelier international intitulé «Prévenir et gérer les incendies de forêt grâce aux coordonnées géospatiales et à l’intelligence artificielle», organisé mardi 8 septembre 2026 à Palerme, en Italie, dans le cadre du programme européen Interreg Next Italie-Tunisie (2021-2027). Selon l’Université de Palerme, l’initiative vise à renforcer la coopération scientifique et opérationnelle entre les deux rives de la Méditerranée, dans un contexte marqué par une augmentation de la fréquence et de l’intensité des incendies de forêt ainsi que par une exposition croissante des zones forestières aux effets du changement climatique. D’une durée de trois ans, le projet a débuté le 15 mai 2025 et s’achèvera le 15 mai 2028. Forfire-AI, acronyme signifiant «Optimisation de la prévention et de la détection des incendies de forêt grâce aux technologies d’IA» , dispose d'un budget global de 773 683 euros, dont 696 314,70 euros proviennent de l’Union européenne (UE) et 77 368,30 euros du cofinancement. Le chef de file du projet est l’École nationale d’ingénieurs de Sousse (Eniso), tandis que le partenariat inclut l’Institut supérieur agronomique de Chott-Mariem, l’Université de Palerme, l’entreprise italienne Seeds et la société tunisienne Robocare. Identifier les zones les plus exposées et intervenir rapidement Le projet se concentre sur le développement d’un système d'alerte et d’une plateforme web capables d’intégrer diverses sources d’information — données météorologiques, capteurs, images satellites et données acquises par drone — afin d’identifier les zones les plus exposées au risque et de favoriser une intervention plus rapide. La plateforme sera expérimentée sur un site pilote en Tunisie et un autre en Sicile, avec pour objectif d’aboutir à des procédures d'alerte reproductibles dans d’autres régions méditerranéennes. Le volet technologique prévoit également l’utilisation de caméras capables de détecter la fumée et les points chauds à une distance estimée entre cinq et dix kilomètres, tout en les distinguant des phénomènes atmosphériques tels que le brouillard et la brume afin de réduire le nombre de fausses alertes. Une fois un foyer potentiel identifié, le système pourra déployer un drone pour acquérir des images en temps réel et les transmettre aux centres opérationnels, fournissant ainsi des informations utiles pour évaluer rapidement l'étendue de l’incendie et coordonner les opérations. Côté tunisien, les premiers tests sont prévus dans la forêt de Dar Chichou, dans la zone d’El Haouaria (gouvernorat de Nabeul, au nord-est du pays). Le système pourra ensuite être étendu à d’autres zones jugées particulièrement vulnérables, notamment Sejnane, dans le gouvernorat de Bizerte, l’une des zones forestières du nord de la Tunisie les plus exposées au risque d’incendie. En Italie, en revanche, l’expérimentation concernera une zone forestière sicilienne. Les recherches portent également sur l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle pour l’analyse automatisée d’images. L’Université de Palerme a récemment lancé une procédure de sélection pour deux bourses de recherche dédiées précisément à la «mise en œuvre de techniques d’IA pour la détection précoce des incendies par analyse visuelle et modèles efficaces» , dans le cadre du projet Forfire-Ai. De la réponse à l’urgence à la prévention informée L’activité scientifique concerne aussi la surveillance de l’état des forêts et du stress hydrique. Dans le cadre du projet, des techniques de télédétection fondées sur des images hyperspectrales et radar SAR ( Synthetic Aperture Radar ) — intégrées à des systèmes d’intelligence artificielle — sont à l’étude pour évaluer l’état des écosystèmes forestiers côtiers méditerranéens et identifier des indicateurs liés au risque d’incendie. L’atelier de Palerme constitue ainsi une étape opérationnelle du projet, visant à articuler recherche universitaire, innovation technologique et gestion concrète des situations d’urgence. Parmi les résultats attendus de Forfire-AI figurent une plateforme numérique, l’intégration de données météorologiques et de surveillance, l’expérimentation sur deux sites pilotes, l’élaboration de procédures d’alerte ainsi que des actions de sensibilisation destinées tant aux décideurs qu’à la population. La logique du projet consiste à déplacer le centre de gravité de la gestion des incendies : passer d’une simple réponse à l’urgence vers une prévention fondée sur les données. Il s’agit de combiner des informations provenant de sources diverses pour identifier en amont les conditions à risque, localiser plus rapidement les foyers potentiels et fournir aux opérateurs une représentation actualisée du territoire. À cet égard, Forfire-AI s’inscrit dans une évolution plus large des politiques européennes de gestion des risques, lesquelles accordent une place croissante à la télédétection, aux données satellitaires et à l’intelligence artificielle pour la cartographie et la prévision des incendies. Selon un document du Parlement européen, l’utilisation coordonnée de données satellitaires, d’informations géospatiales et de la surveillance au sol est considérée comme un outil stratégique pour renforcer les capacités de prévention et d’intervention dans les zones méditerranéennes. I. B. (avec Agenzia Nova ). L’article Tunisie-Italie | L’IA contre les incendies de forêt est apparu en premier sur Kapitalis .

items.title: New Apple CEO to face first test with foldable iPhone launch
items.description: Apple is expected to unveil a slew of new and updated devices, including a long-rumored foldable iPhone, when it holds its annual late-summer hardware event on Wednesday in Cupertino, California. It will also be the first major event under new chief executive John Ternus, who took over from outgoing CEO Tim Cook on September 1. Ternus, 51, joined Apple’s design team in 2001 and worked his way up to leading the engineering teams behind Apple’s entire product lineup, including the iPhones that generate most of the company’s revenue. The event, which Ternus promised would be “phenomenal” in his first company-wide email as CEO last week, will kick off at 10 am local time (1700 GMT). The tech giant is expected to finally reveal a long-awaited foldable iPhone, currently rumored to be called the iPhone Ultra, which will start at $2,000, according to reports. Like Samsung’s foldable smartphones, Apple’s device will have a smaller external display when closed and a much larger screen that unfolds when the phone is opened. The format essentially combines the portability of a smartphone with the larger display of a tablet, offering users a larger screen without carrying a tablet-sized device. The foldable will be a test for Apple, which has not launched a breakout hit since the AirPods 10 years ago. Samsung launched the industry’s first mainstream foldable smartphone, the Galaxy Fold, in 2019. The South Korean company released an updated model, the Galaxy Z Fold, last year at a starting price of $2,000. Foldable smartphones make up a tiny fraction of the market, at less than 2 percent of global shipments, but Apple could take 31 percent of that demand by the end of the year and reach 40 percent by 2027, according to research firm IDC. “Apple’s foldable iPhone is very likely to shift the competitive dynamics both in China and global markets,” IDC research associate Kiranjeet Kaur told AFP. The foldable iPhone’s release comes as demand for powerful chips amid the artificial intelligence (AI) boom has created a supply chain crunch, pushing prices higher across industries. As a result, smartphone shipments will decline by more than 16 percent this year while the average cost jumps more than 27 percent, according to IDC. “Foldable phones are not immune to the memory supply shortages, but the relative impact is lower considering these phones are already priced in the higher-range,” Kaur said. In what would be a first for Apple, it is unclear whether the company will launch a new entry-level iPhone this year. According to various reports, the company might only unveil two higher-end versions of its next series: the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. A more affordable base version, the iPhone 18, might not launch until next year. The foldable Ultra will be around the size of a passport when closed and have only two camera lenses, a regular and an ultra-wide lens, according to Bloomberg. An improved version of Siri, powered by AI, will be integrated into many of the new devices announced, which could include watches, AirPods, an Apple TV box and the HomePod mini. The company might also launch a 7-inch device with a screen meant to act as a smart home hub, Bloomberg reported, though it is unclear whether that will be unveiled Wednesday or later this year. AFP The post New Apple CEO to face first test with foldable iPhone launch appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: UEMOA : L’inflation ressort à 1,7 % en août 2026
items.description: Le Gouverneur de la Banque centrale des États de l’Afrique de l’Ouest (BCEAO), Jean-Claude Kassi Brou, a présidé ce 09 septembre 2026, l’ouverture de la troisième session du Comité de politique monétaire de l’année 2026. Ce rendez-vous se tiendra, selon lui, dans un contexte marqué par les effets de la crise au Moyen-Orient qui ont perturbé les chaînes d’approvisionnement et renchéri les coûts. Un contexte qui, d’après lui, n’est pas resté sans conséquences pour les économies de l’UEMOA. Le secteur énergétique a été affecté avec le relèvement des prix du carburant dans 7 des 8 pays membres. Le taux d'inflation de l'Union est ressorti à 0,4 % en glissement annuel au deuxième trimestre de 2026, contre 0,2 % au trimestre précédent. Cette inflation, soutient M. Brou, a progressé pour atteindre 1,2 % en juillet et 1,7 % en août 2026. Cette accélération, selon le Gouverneur de la BCEAO, a été favorisée par la hausse des prix du transport, du logement et de certains produits alimentaires, notamment la viande, les poissons et les légumes. Pour le reste de l'année 2026, cette dynamique haussière des prix devrait se poursuivre, du fait notamment des impacts négatifs de la crise au Moyen-Orient. Au niveau des finances publiques, le déficit budgétaire global au premier semestre 2026 est ressorti à 3,4 % du PIB, contre 3,2 % un an plus tôt. Pour l'année 2026, il a été révisé à la hausse comparativement aux prévisions réalisées au mois de juin 2026, en raison notamment des mesures prises par les États membres pour atténuer les effets socio-économiques de l'impact de la crise au Moyen-Orient sur les populations. Pour ce qui est de l’équilibre extérieur de l'Union, il est demeuré stable pour le deuxième trimestre 2026. « Pour l'année 2026, le profil des comptes extérieurs devait refléter l'évolution moins favorable des termes de l'échange consécutifs aux tensions géopolitiques. Sur le marché monétaire, les conditions se sont globalement assouplies au deuxième trimestre 2026, portées par une liquidité bancaire confortable et la réduction de 25 points de base des taux directeurs de la BCEAO », a dit Jean-Claude Kassi Brou. Demba DIENG

items.title: Plan national villes intelligentes : ce que le Cameroun va changer dans ses villes
items.description: © DR S’il ne dort pas dans les tiroirs comme d’autres similaires, ce plan est la feuille de route qui va transformer Yaoundé, Douala, Bafoussam, Garoua et toutes les villes camerounaises en villes plus inclusives, connectées et durables. Lancé officiellement le mardi 08 septembre 2026 par le ministère de l’Habitat et du Développement urbain- Minhdu, le ministère des Postes et Télécommunications- Minpostel et ONU-Habitat, le Plan d'action national pour le développement des villes intelligentes est désormais officiel. Il repose sur 3 piliers majeurs présentés comme les axes stratégiques. D’abord la technologie au service de la gestion urbaine. L'idée est d'utiliser le numérique pour régler les problèmes du quotidien : gestion du trafic, collecte des déchets, éclairage public intelligent, sécurisation des quartiers, digitalisation des services municipaux. Fini les files interminables à la mairie pour un acte de naissance. Ensuite l'innovation et l'inclusion sociale. Le Plan vise à ne laisser personne de côté. Il prévoit des services connectés accessibles aux populations, le soutien aux startups locales et aux PME du numérique, et l'implication des universités comme l’Ecole nationale supérieure polytechnique Yaoundé I pour créer des solutions camerounaises aux problèmes camerounais. Enfin, une gouvernance modernisée. C'est le cœur du dispositif. Il s'agit de donner de vrais outils aux Collectivités territoriales décentralisées (CTD). Les mairies et régions ne seront plus de simples spectatrices. Elles deviennent les actrices principales de la transformation, avec un cadre d'intervention clair et des financements dédiés. Ce plan entre en jeu au moment où le Cameroun fait face à une urbanisation accélérée et souvent anarchique. Des villes étouffent en raison des embouteillages, inondations, insécurité, chômage des jeunes. Ce Plan arrive comme une réponse directe au défi climatique pour permettre de rendre les villes plus résilientes aux inondations et à la chaleur grâce à des données et des capteurs. Au défi socio-économique en permettant de créer des emplois dans le numérique et rendre les villes plus attractives pour les investisseurs. Au défi de la décentralisation en donnant aux mairies les moyens technologiques et financiers de gérer leurs territoires. Pour la mise en œuvre du plan dans le volet infrastructurel, le Cameroun s'appuie sur les opérateurs Orange, MTN, CAMTEL ; sur le FEICOM pour le financement des communes ; et sur l'ANTIC pour la régulation numérique. Le PNUD, la Banque mondiale, la Banque africaine de développement, l’Union européenne sont des partenaires qui vont accompagner la mise en œuvre du plan. Cet article Plan national villes intelligentes : ce que le Cameroun va changer dans ses villes est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .

items.title: Weija Dam spillage determined by water inflows, not fixed schedule – GWL
items.description: Ghana Water Limited (GWL) says spillage from the Weija Dam is not governed by a fixed annual schedule but is determined largely by the volume of water flowing into the dam. The Head of Public Relations and Communications at GWL, Stanley Martey, said the dam could spill for several weeks in some years, depending on rainfall and inflows, while releases could also be halted and resumed as water levels change. Speaking on Joy FM’s Super Morning Show on Wednesday, September 9, Mr Martey said the amount of water entering the dam is the key factor in determining when spillage becomes necessary. “It depends on the inputs. If we have more inputs, we will spill,” he explained. He said authorities monitor the dam’s water level and consider spillage when it approaches the threshold considered necessary for safe operation. According to Mr Martey, during the major rainy season, spillage may begin at about 44 feet, when inflows can rise rapidly and remain high. During the minor rainy season, authorities may allow the level to rise slightly higher, to about 45 feet, before releasing excess water. He stressed that the duration and frequency of spillage therefore depend on prevailing rainfall and inflow conditions rather than a predetermined timetable. The clarification comes amid renewed concerns over the latest spillage from the Weija Dam and its impact on communities along the Densu River. Mr Martey also expressed concern that some residents living along the river course remain reluctant to relocate to safer areas despite repeated warnings from authorities. He said the continued occupation and development of areas vulnerable to rising water levels increases the risk of flooding whenever the dam has to release excess water.

items.title: Violences en France: la ville de Chambéry s’embrase après la mort par balle d’un jeune automobiliste
items.description: FRANCE-VIOLENCE-MORT-BALLE-AUTOMOBILISTE Violences en France: la ville de Chambéry s’embrase après la mort par balle d’un jeune automobiliste Ouagadougou, 9 sept. 2026 (AIB)- La ville de Chambéry, dans le sud-est de la France, a été secouée, dans la nuit du 7 au 8 septembre 2026, par de violentes émeutes ayant entraîné l’incendie d’un centre social, de bâtiments privés, d’édifices publics ainsi que de véhicules, après la mort par balle d’un jeune automobiliste à la suite d’un contrôle policier. Plusieurs dizaines d’individus ont pris part aux violences dans plusieurs quartiers de Chambéry et dans la commune voisine de Cognin, mettant le feu à des véhicules, des poubelles et plusieurs bâtiments, selon la presse. Le centre social du Biollay a été complétement détruit par les flammes. Des locaux privés et des commerces ont aussi été dégradés. Des forces de l’ordre ont dû intervenir pour contenir les violences. Des renforts de la CRS 83 ont été déployés dans la ville afin de prévenir une nouvelle flambée au cours de la nuit suivante. À l’origine de cette nouvelle nuit de tensions, la découverte, lundi soir, d’un automobiliste grièvement blessé par balle à la tête lors d’une intervention policière. Le conducteur, retrouvé blessé dans son véhicule après un contrôle routier, a été transporté à l’hôpital avant de succomber à ses blessures mardi, selon le procureur. La mort du jeune homme a rapidement alimenté les tensions dans les quartiers concernés. Des rumeurs faisant état d’un tir policier ont circulé, contribuant à l’embrasement de la situation. Le parquet a toutefois indiqué que les circonstances exactes de la blessure restaient à établir. Une enquête a été confiée à l’Inspection générale de la Police nationale (IGPN) afin de faire la lumière sur les circonstances de la blessure et du décès. Les enquêteurs doivent notamment déterminer l’origine du tir et établir les responsabilités éventuelles. En attendant les conclusions des investigations, les autorités françaises font face à une situation particulièrement tendue, où une intervention policière suivie du décès d’un jeune homme a rapidement débouché sur des violences, des incendies et d’importantes destructions. Cette nouvelle flambée à Chambéry vient surtout rappeler le climat de tension qui persiste dans certaines villes françaises, où les rapports entre une partie de la population et les forces de sécurité demeurent fragiles. En quelques heures, un contrôle routier a ainsi dégénéré en violences urbaines, laissant derrière lui des bâtiments détruits, des véhicules incendiés et une population plongée dans l’inquiétude. La situation illustre une France confrontée à des épisodes de violences urbaines récurrents, sur fond de défiance, de tensions sociales et de contestation de l’action des forces de sécurité. À Chambéry, comme ailleurs, le moindre incident peut désormais rapidement prendre une ampleur considérable, mettant à rude épreuve l’autorité publique. Agence d’Information du Burkina Source : Medias

items.title: Canada lists 17 countries whose citizens can enter with eTA instead of visa
items.description: Canada has listed 17 countries whose citizens may be eligible to travel to the country by air with an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) instead of a visitor visa, subject to meeting specific requirements. The eTA option is available to citizens of certain countries whose nationals normally require a visa to enter Canada. However, eligibility is not automatic. Travellers must meet all the requirements set by the Canadian government before applying for an eTA. To qualify, travellers must have held a Canadian visitor visa within the past 10 years or currently hold a valid United States non-immigrant visa. They must also be travelling to Canada for a temporary stay, normally of up to six months, and must be flying to or transiting through a Canadian airport using a valid passport from one of the eligible countries. Citizens who do not meet all three conditions will still need to apply for a Canadian visitor visa. 17 countries whose citizens may be eligible for Canada eTA Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Brazil Costa Rica Indonesia Malaysia Mexico Morocco Panama Philippines St Kitts and Nevis St Lucia St Vincent and the Grenadines Seychelles Thailand Trinidad and Tobago Uruguay Indonesia and Malaysia are the latest additions to the list. eTA only applies to air travel The eTA arrangement applies specifically to travellers flying to or transiting through a Canadian airport. Eligible citizens who plan to enter Canada by car, bus, train or boat must still obtain a valid visitor visa. This includes people travelling to Canada from the United States by car and those arriving by bus, train or cruise ship. Travellers with an existing Canadian visa People who already have a valid Canadian visitor visa do not need to obtain an eTA to fly to Canada. They can continue travelling with their visitor visa until it expires. Requirements when flying with an eTA Travellers must use the same passport used when applying for their eTA. Anyone who receives a new passport after obtaining an eTA must apply for a new eTA using the new passport. Canadian authorities also recommend carrying an old passport if it contains an expired Canadian visitor visa or a valid US non-immigrant visa. The US visa must have been valid at the time the traveller applied for the eTA, although it does not necessarily have to remain valid on the date they travel to Canada. Canadian citizens and permanent residents Canadian citizens, including dual citizens, cannot apply for an eTA and must travel to Canada by air with a valid Canadian passport. Canadian permanent residents also cannot use an eTA. They must travel with a valid permanent resident card or permanent resident travel document. items.title: Woman found dead in Calabar hotel, police begin probe
items.description: The Police Command in Cross River says it has begun investigation on the case suspected of homicide involving an unidentified female guest at a hotel in Calabar. The Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), ASP Sunday Eitokpah, who disclosed this in a statement in Calabar said that the incident occurred along Clifford Street, Calabar metropolis. Eitokpah said the incident was reported to the command on Tuesday director of the hotel who was accompanied by the manager, and the receptionist on duty. He said that preliminary investigation revealed that an unidentified male guest lodged at the hotel with a lady whose identity had yet to be established. “The male guest was not properly documented at the point of admission into the hotel. The police image maker said that a receptionist on duty discovered that the room occupied by the guests was open. “When the room was accessed, the female guest was found lying unresponsive on the bed,” he said. Eitokpah said that police investigators who visited the scene observed apparent marks of violence on the lady’s face and neck. He said that the lady was taken to a Hospital where she was confirmed dead, and that the remains had been deposited at the morgue. The PPRO said that the receptionist was currently being interrogated to establish the circumstances surrounding the admission of the guests. “The receptionist’s detention should not be seen as a determination of guilt. It is part of the investigation process,” he said. The police spokesperson said that the command had launched its dragnet to track down the male guest who reportedly checked into the hotel with the deceased. He said that the Commissioner of Police, CP Ajo Ordue, had directed full investigation into the matter to ensure that justice prevailed. “The commissioner has called for professional and objective investigation on the matter. We must establish the identity of the deceased. “We must unravel the circumstances behind her death, and the roles, if any, of all persons connected with the incident,” he said. Eitokpah urged members of the public to desist from speculation and circulation of unverified information capable of prejudicing the investigation process. He urged members of the public with credible information that could assist in identifying the deceased or locating the male guest to contact the nearest police station. (NAN) The post Woman found dead in Calabar hotel, police begin probe appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Nahouri/Journée de l’excellence scolaire 2026 : Moumouni Assinga décroche la 2e place nationale au Bac C avec 17/20
items.description: BURKINA-NAHOURI-EDUCATION Nahouri/Journée de l’excellence scolaire 2026 : Moumouni Assinga décroche la 2e place nationale au Bac C avec 17/20 Pô, 9 sept. 2026 (AIB)-Elève du lycée provincial de Pô, Moumouni Assinga a honoré la province du Nahouri en se classant deuxième au plan national au baccalauréat série C, avec une moyenne de 17/20. Cette brillante performance lui a valu d’être distingué lors de la Journée de l’excellence scolaire 2026, présidée le 4 septembre 2026 à Ouagadougou par le Président du Faso, le Capitaine Ibrahim Traoré. La province du Nahouri s’est illustrée sur la scène éducative nationale à travers l’élève Moumouni Assinga, officiellement distingué lors de la Journée de l’excellence scolaire 2026, tenue le 4 septembre à Ouagadougou sous la présidence du président du Faso, le capitaine Ibrahim Traoré. Issu de la toute première promotion de la série C du lycée provincial de Pô, le jeune lauréat s’est classé deuxième au niveau national au baccalauréat série C, avec une remarquable moyenne de 17/20. Pour concrétiser cette reconnaissance des autorités nationales, Moumouni Assinga a reçu une attestation de mérite, un ordinateur portable ainsi que d’autres récompenses destinées à l’encourager dans la poursuite de son parcours académique. Cette performance dépasse le cadre d’un simple succès individuel, elle contribue au rayonnement de la province du Nahouri et de la région du Nazinon. Elle témoigne également des efforts conjugués du corps professoral, de la direction de l’établissement, des parents d’élèves et des apprenants eux-mêmes. Accueillant cette distinction avec fierté, le proviseur du lycée provincial de Pô, Roméo Ouédraogo, a salué les efforts et le dévouement de l’ensemble de la communauté éducative. Il a réaffirmé la détermination de l’établissement à maintenir cette dynamique afin de continuer à figurer parmi les références de l’enseignement secondaire au Burkina Faso lors des prochaines sessions. items.title: Ghana’s economy grows 6.0% in Q2 2026, first-half growth hits 6.2% – GSS
items.description: Ghana’s economy grew by 6.0% in the second quarter of 2026, bringing growth for the first half of the year to 6.2%, according to the Ghana Statistical Service (GSS). The latest quarterly growth represents a slight slowdown from the 6.1% recorded in the second quarter of 2025. Non-oil GDP also remained resilient, growing by 5.4% in the second quarter, while non-oil growth for the first half of 2026 reached 5.9%. The latest figures show that economic expansion continues to be driven largely by the services sector, particularly information and communications technology (ICT), alongside oil and gas production and investment. Services lead growth The services sector grew by 8.0% in the second quarter and accounted for 57.6% of overall GDP growth during the period. ICT was the strongest-performing activity within the sector, recording growth of 30.9% and contributing 41.5% of total GDP growth in the quarter. The performance underscores the growing contribution of services and digital-related activities to overall economic expansion. Industry boosted by oil and gas The industrial sector expanded by 4.3% in the second quarter, supported partly by a strong rebound in oil and gas production. Oil and gas activity grew by 21.4% during the period, helping to lift overall industrial performance. However, the broader industrial sector grew at a more moderate pace compared with services, indicating that the expansion was not evenly spread across all productive activities. Agriculture growth remains subdued Agriculture recorded growth of 3.9% in the second quarter, making it one of the weaker-performing broad sectors. The sector was weighed down by a sharp contraction in fishing activity, which declined by 24.7% during the period. The relatively slower agricultural growth contrasts with the stronger performance of services and ICT. Investment and domestic demand rise Investment recorded a significant increase of 53.0% in the second quarter, while domestic demand grew by 11.2%. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, seasonally adjusted real GDP increased by 1.4%, indicating that economic activity continued to expand during the period. The latest figures point to continued momentum in Ghana’s economy, although the performance remains concentrated in particular sectors and activities. The strong contribution from services, ICT, oil and investment has supported overall growth, while agriculture and parts of industry have recorded more modest expansion. With first-half GDP growth at 6.2% and non-oil growth at 5.9%, the data point to continued resilience in the economy. A key policy challenge will be ensuring that growth becomes broader-based across productive sectors and translates into stronger employment and household incomes.

items.title: Ouagadougou : La délégation spéciale rappelle la réglementation sur les cortèges et invite au respect strict des dispositions
items.description: La présidence de la délégation spéciale (PDS) de la commune de Ouagadougou a publié, ce 8 septembre 2026, un communiqué rappelant à l’ensemble des citoyens la réglementation en vigueur relative à la formation des cortèges. Ce rappel fait suite au constat du non-respect, par certains bénéficiaires d’autorisations, des dispositions prévues à cet effet. La formation des cortèges dans la commune de Ouagadougou est régie par l’arrêté n°2024-270/CO/MICAB/DAJC du 12 décembre 2024. Selon ce texte, est considéré comme cortège « toute suite de personnes avançant ou défilant au moyen d’engins motorisés ou non, en l’honneur d’une personne ou à l’occasion d’un événement ». Sont toutefois exclus de cette définition les cortèges funèbres, les cortèges officiels ainsi que ceux des Forces de défense et de sécurité et de leurs auxiliaires. L’arrêté fixe des conditions précises pour la formation des cortèges. Toute organisation d’un cortège doit faire l’objet d’une déclaration préalable auprès de l’autorité communale compétente, au moins 72 heures avant la tenue de l’événement. Cette déclaration doit notamment préciser les identités et adresses complètes des trois principaux responsables, ainsi que le jour, l’heure et l’itinéraire prévus. L’autorité compétente dispose ensuite d’un délai de 24 heures avant la date prévue pour formuler, le cas échéant, ses observations à l’endroit des responsables. Le texte encadre également strictement la composition des cortèges. Ceux-ci ne peuvent excéder dix véhicules automobiles et cinq engins à deux roues. La circulation en file indienne est obligatoire afin d’éviter d’occuper toute l’emprise de la voie publique. L’utilisation de tricycles dans les cortèges est, par ailleurs, formellement interdite. L’autorité compétente peut, lorsque les circonstances l’exigent, interdire la tenue d’un cortège sur certaines voies ou à certaines heures, en modifier l’itinéraire ou encore y mettre fin à tout moment sur la voie publique ou dans les lieux publics, lorsque le maintien de l’ordre l’exige. Tout contrevenant s’expose aux sanctions prévues par les textes en vigueur. L’exécution de l’arrêté incombe au secrétaire général de la mairie de Ouagadougou, au commandant de la compagnie de gendarmerie du Kadiogo et au commissaire central de police de la ville. Ce rappel des autorités intervient dans un contexte marqué par la volonté de renforcer la sécurité et de préserver l’ordre public dans la commune de Ouagadougou. La pratique de cortèges non conformes à la réglementation, notamment à l’occasion de cérémonies de mariage et d’autres événements festifs, peut entraîner des perturbations de la circulation et accroître les risques d’accidents. Josué TIENDREBEOGO Faso7 L’article Ouagadougou : La délégation spéciale rappelle la réglementation sur les cortèges et invite au respect strict des dispositions est apparu en premier sur Faso7 .

items.title: Apple expected to unveil first folding phone, with new CEO Ternus in command
items.description: Apple is widely ‌expected to unveil a pricey folding iPhone at a launch event on Wednesday at its Cupertino, California, headquarters. The event, the first with new CEO John Ternus at the helm, will be the most noticeable overhaul of Apple’s flagship product since it removed ​the physical home button from the iPhone X in 2017. The iPhone brought in $209.6 billion, or just over ​half of Apple’s sales, in its most recent fiscal year. The keynote address will ⁠also be the first extended commentary from Ternus, who previously served as Apple’s hardware chief but has ​kept a low public profile aside from a handful of product introductions and sustainability initiatives. It will fall ​to Ternus to persuade Apple’s customers that they need a foldable device that could cost more than $2,000, a new high for a global brand that has defined mass luxury. While Samsung Electronics and Huawei Technologies have sold folding phones since 2019, ​the devices have remained a niche among tech enthusiasts. But even with a steep price tag, analyst ​firms such as IDC expect Apple will sell every foldable iPhone it can produce and secure 40% share of the lucrative niche ‌by ⁠the end of next year. Analysts also expect Apple to benefit from its late entry into the folding phone category by mastering key engineering challenges such as creating an elegant-but-sturdy hinge that can survive repeated opening and minimize how much of a crease shows where the screen folds. One key remaining challenge could be how ​well the devices resist dust ​and water, an area in ⁠which Google’s most recent Pixel 10 Pro Fold bested Samsung’s offerings with what is known as an IP68 rating, meaning the device is dust-tight and can be ​dunked in a meter of water. Wednesday’s event is also expected to mark a ​major change ⁠in Apple’s annual product schedule. While analysts expect Apple to show off new watches, they anticipate the company will hold off on updates to its more affordable iPhone models until next spring and instead focus only on the new folding device and ⁠its ​iPhone Pro and Pro Max lineup. The move is aimed at ​smoothing out Apple’s annual sales cycle, which typically shows a large bump in revenues during the year-end holiday quarter for the U.S. ​and Europe.
